workload_a_fixture.interpretation: Wall-clock speedup (1.42x) badly understates the GPU benefit because a 2-page run is dominated by one-off model loading. Steady-state layout inference is 8.9x. Reporting total_runtime/pages as an inference rate would be wrong by ~6x here.

Neither is a clean CPU baseline. They are recorded as upper bounds and are NOT used for a headline speedup.
